name: Thor
source:
The form taken on by the Goddess of Summer, Thor, after she has succumbed to corruption by Loki.

Having been taught by Loki to be more honest and greedy with her own desires, she considers her corrupted form something to be proud of.

Considering she already enjoyed fighting in her normal form, and now enjoys destruction after being corrupted...One could say that this form is perhaps what she should have originally been.

「I'll make sure to devote myself more to you, my Master...so, could you maybe pay more attention to me from now on?」

Wepon names: Mjolnir, Jarngreip
